title: Residual-dimension obstructions for null-projected supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories — submission package
description:
Residual-dimension obstructions for null-projected supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories. Version 2.0.0 holds the fourth version of the Hexagon preprint in the folder hexagon-v4 (NullProjectedSYM_v4.pdf, 31 pages, its TeX ZIP with the Python programs in anc/, unpacked source, arXiv tarball, Hexagon portal fields and AI provenance file), replacing https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00471v3. Two theorems are new. Theorem 5.12 shows that the conditions of the Main Theorem are sufficient when the residual dimension is ten: Nishino's theories carry over, by a complex isometry that keeps the total dimension and the rank of the null frame, to every signature with s+t-2k = 10 and s-t in {8, 0, -8}, with a Majorana-Weyl gaugino; in particular theories exist in 9+9 and 9+17 (Corollary 5.13). Theorem 7.3 drops the null contraction of the translation bracket and allows any fixed tensor in the source that absorbs the cubic gaugino terms: the residual dimension is then at most 14, so no contraction rescues the signatures (11+8n)+3 and their companions with n >= 1, including 27+3 (Corollary 7.4). Appendix E and the program contraction_check.py check both in explicit gamma matrices (32 checks). Citations of unrefereed preprints were replaced by published versions or removed.

The paper proves necessary residual-dimension and signature conditions for null-projected supersymmetric Yang-Mills constructions under five explicit axioms, their sufficiency for residual dimension ten, and a separate unitary helicity-span obstruction. Existence for residual dimension two and theories outside the five axioms are not decided.

Verification scope: No general Lean formalisation is claimed. The proofs are written in the manuscript; the gamma-matrix calculations are supplementary finite numerical checks.

Earlier preprint versions: https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00471v1, https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00471v2 and https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00471v3. The third version is version 1.6.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23746593.
